query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS restaurant_reservations (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (UUID()),
  reference VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  restaurant_reservation_type ENUM('particulier', 'entreprise', 'groupe') NOT NULL,
  slotId VARCHAR(50),
  restaurant_display_choice VARCHAR(50),
  seatsTotal INT NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  companyName VARCHAR(255),
  groupName VARCHAR(255),
  groupType VARCHAR(50),
  restaurant_reservation_status ENUM('pending_validation', 'validated_pending_payment', 'paid_confirmed', 'refused', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'no_show') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_validation',
  restaurant_payment_status ENUM('not_requested', 'pending_payment', 'paid', 'failed', 'refunded') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_requested',
  paymentAmount DECIMAL(10, 2),
  paymentProvider VARCHAR(50),
  paymentReference VARCHAR(255),
  qrToken VARCHAR(255),
  restaurant_qr_status ENUM('inactive', 'active', 'used', 'expired') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inactive',
  expiresAt DATETIME,
  processedBy VARCHAR(255),
  processedAt DATETIME,
  notes TEXT,
  createdAt DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_reference (reference),
  INDEX idx_status (restaurant_reservation_status),
  INDEX idx_type (restaurant_reservation_type),
  INDEX idx_email (email)
);
